result.verdict:
83/100. Not ready to ship. There is one high defect: a fast flick skips the held scroll stories. This is the owner's L-027 request, it was live in f42b898c, and it has since been removed. There is also one medium truth defect: the page promises "Save your answers" and "Start free to keep these answers", but nothing carries the guest's sample answers into the new account. Most of the round 12 truth fixes held up when checked against the code: the Benchmarks gate (aiCommerce off, so college and DU levels "Opens soon"), the sample label "Sample full mock, first 10 questions", 14:59 and 1:12 pace, the 20:00 benchmark allowance, "answer key" in place of "official", the tie rule for the next move, "Across your mocks" in place of the Score Recovery Lab, PYQ guide, the repair cost of 1 AI credit with Free at 10 a month, Compass Pro's 8 colleges (MAX_COLLEGES) and 250 marks a paper, 100 starting credits with Quick 10 and Full 50, NTA interface switching and strike-out, and the 199K follower total (161,411 + 25,273 + 12,662 + 188). All the numbers in the Mistake Lab add up across Time, Changes, Repair, SWOT, Replay, Weak chapters, Ask Mobi and Across your mocks: 22 marks, net -6, 28 marks missed, Partnership 12/12/18, 3 of 10, Ratios 14 of 15, Cash flow 9 of 14. Section 13(d) is cited correctly.

What I captured (saved in mockmob-next\tmp\landing-1017\critic-r13-b):
- Wheel-scrolled frames in Night and Day at 390x844 (102 frames each) and 1440x900 (90 frames each), about 0.2 of a screen apart inside the 3 held stories, with contact sheets in each folder's sheets/. I opened all 40 sheets.
- Fast-flick runs at 390 and 1440 (fling-*/_sheet.jpeg) and a 40-frame reduced-motion run at 390 (rm-390/_sheet.jpeg).
- In b-own/: a true first visit (first/), visitor states via ?dock=member and sampled or partial localStorage (states/), the sample flow at both widths (drill-*), real-pointer sweeps at 390 Night and 1440 Day (sweep-*), a lower-page sweep (lower-night-390), anchors, logo, menu and theme switch (anchor-*), the full repair panel (repair-390), and the page text from the server HTML (server-text.txt).
- Dev-server reloads (HMR) reset pages mid-flow during this run, so my later scripts block the HMR socket.

What I clicked, each with a real pointer after hit-testing:
- Logo: returns to top at both widths.
- Nav: "Your prep tools" lands with the section top at 78 px. PYQ guide and Pricing are present.
- Theme switch works (light to dark). The menu opens with Theme, 6 links, Log in and Start free.
- Hero: Start free goes to /signup, and Try 5 questions glides to the sample.
- Sample: all 5 questions at 390 (all wrong) and 1440 (mixed). The result names a chapter only with 2 or more misses and no tie. The sample record is stored, the hero key changes to "Back to the sample", and Try another subject and More subjects (10 more) work.
- Lab: Time, Changes, Repair and SWOT tabs, and Read the full repair opens and closes.
- Feature tour: all 5 tabs, Previous, Next and Pause demos.
- Across your mocks: all 4 steps.
- Compass: programme, category and round chips, Try 650/800/950, and the slider.
- DU teaser: all 22 subject chips and See programmes (goes to /cuet-cutoff-calculator?s=...).
- College tiles open the calculator. Exam comparator: MockMob/NTA switch, options, Mark, Clear, Save and Next, palette and Reset.
- All 6 Instagram Watch buttons play the reel inline. All 6 FAQ answers expand.
- Pricing: Start free goes to /signup. Close: Try 5 questions glides back to the sample.
- Footer: the logo returns to top.

Other results:
- No overflow in any frame, no console errors and no page errors.
- No viewport ever showed two volt primary keys (scanned at 390 Night and 1440 Day).
- No text under 12 px. Headings use one scale: 42/32/22 on phone and 64/48/30 on desktop. The close heading is 56 at 1440.
- No theme hint appears on a first visit.
- Reduced motion shows the full statement, a still type line and instant swaps with autoplay off.
- All internal links return 200.

defects.section: Held stories (Mistake Lab cinema, What's inside MockMob, Across your mocks), 390 and 1440
defects.what: One fast flick skips several steps and whole stories. This breaks the owner's L-027, L-028 and L-029. One-gesture-one-step was live in f42b898c; land2 removed it in landing fixer rounds 2 and 3 (323f6d29: 'held stories scroll 1:1'), and ScrollStory.jsx lines 31-35 now say nothing cancels a wheel or swipe.
defects.evidence: critic-r13-b/fling-390/_sheet.jpeg: one burst of 14 x 400 px wheel moved 5,600 px from the top to the Lab's SWOT step (Time, Changes and Repair skipped). The next burst went through the whole tour and into Across your mocks. fling-1440.log shows the same.
defects.fix: Restore gesture stepping inside the pinned range only. While a story's stage is pinned, a wheel or touch gesture (a burst of events with gaps under 180 ms) calls preventDefault and goTo(step plus or minus 1), with a 440 ms glide and a lock until the glide ends and the input goes idle. At the first and last step, release the gesture so the page continues. Keep keyboard, scrollbar, find-in-page and reduced motion as they are (reduced motion: instant swap). Add a harness check that a 14 x 400 burst and a fast touch swipe each move exactly one step in all 3 stories at 390 and 1440 with no page drift.

defects.section: Phone dock and close band, sampled visitor
defects.what: For a visitor who has answered sample questions, the dock label says 'Save your answers' and the close says 'Start free to keep these answers' with the key 'Start free and see your next move'. Nothing carries the answers into the account: mm:sample:v1 stores only {answered, done, subject, focus}, and no client code calls /api/me/sample-import (grep finds only the route and its test). After sign-up the answers and the sample's next move are lost.
defects.evidence: b-own/states (sampled): dock 'Save your answers Start free'; close 'Start free to keep these answers and get the next move from your own record. Start free and see your next move'. HeroDockGate.jsx:244 and CloseActions.jsx:21. grep for 'sample-import' finds no caller.
defects.fix: Either wire it: DemoDrill also stores each pick with its SAMPLE_VERSION question id, and the first authenticated load posts it to /api/me/sample-import, then shows it in the dashboard. Or say only what is true: dock label 'Your next move is one step away' (or no label), close sub 'Start free to get your next move from your own record.', key 'Start free'. Add a landingCopy test banning 'Save your answers' and 'keep these answers' while nothing calls sample-import.

defects.section: Close band, partial sample (1 to 4 answered)
defects.what: A visitor who answered only 1 or 2 questions gets the heading 'Five questions. Then your next move.'
defects.evidence: b-own/states partial (answered 2): close 'Five questions. Then your next move.' The 390 sweep after a single answer shows the same heading.
defects.fix: Branch on sample.done. When not done, use 'Your sample is waiting.' with the sub 'Finish the five, then start free for your next move.'

defects.what: At first paint the type line reads 'Down to the chapter.' and the next line starts 'Then it picks the chapter for tonight', so 'chapter' appears twice in 2 lines.
defects.fix: Make the server or first phrase 'the minute.' (keep the order minute, changed answer, reason, chapter), or change the lead to 'Then it picks what to practise tonight and keeps your DU shortlist in sight...'.

defects.what: The heading is still a full H2 (32 px phone, 48 px desktop), as dominant as every other H2. The green MockMob appears only in the docked mini label, so the owner's 'smaller, less dominant, MockMob in green' is half done.
defects.evidence: vol scan headings: H2.lp-h2 32px and 48px 'What's inside MockMob.' Frames f027 (390) and f029 (1440).
defects.fix: Set this one heading a step down (22 px phone, 36 px desktop) with the sub on the same baseline group. Keep the green MockMob in the mini label that docks, so the heading has no one-word accent.

defects.what: Commerce comes first only as a bold run-in inside a 15 px note under the shelf. The hero and the bank heading never say commerce.
defects.evidence: server-text.txt line 67; day-390 f004 and day-1440 f003.
defects.fix: Under the bank H2, add an 18 px sub as part of the hierarchy: 'Built first for CUET Commerce: English, Accountancy, Business Studies and Economics.' Drop the run-in from the note.

defects.what: Defensive fine print remains: the FAQ 'Is MockMob affiliated with NTA or DU? No. MockMob is independent.' and the sample result line 'Five questions are a small sample, so this says little yet.' The second also sits right above a named next move.
defects.fix: Replace the affiliation FAQ with 'Where do the exam pattern and DU rules come from?' and answer 'From what NTA and DU publish.' For a low score, use 'A full mock of 50 shows the pattern; here is where to start.'

defects.what: There are still 14 font sizes at 390 and 15 at 1440; the target is 12 or fewer. 13 px and 15 px sit next to 12, 14 and 16.
defects.fix: Fold 15 px into 16 and 13 px into 12 or 14 (the card meta and tour points), and fold the 40 and 24 px phone sizes into 42 and 22.

defects.section: Tour at 390, entry and anchor landing
defects.what: When the tour is reached from 'Your prep tools' or while scrolling into it, the dock covers 'Start practising' and the last lede line ('Unlimited with Pro.').
defects.fix: Give #your-prep scroll-margin-top for the docked label, and give the tour stage at 768 px or below padding-bottom of var(--dock-h) + 12px so the action row clears the dock.

defects.what: The four college photos are blank (Night 1440) or grey (390, mid-flick) when they come into view, then pop in.
defects.evidence: night-1440 sheet-08 f080 (blank tiles); fling-390 fl-04-mid vs fl-05-rest.
defects.fix: Lazy-load them with rootMargin 1500px, or loading='eager' with fetchpriority='low' since they are small, and use a tinted placeholder that matches each photo's average colour.

defects.section: Desktop balance, What's inside MockMob at 1440
defects.what: Each tour slide (copy column plus a roughly 550 px demo card) fills only about 40% of the 900 px held screen, leaving an empty band above 'Pause demos'. The Across your mocks stepper column is also thin beside its card.
defects.fix: At 1200 px and up, widen the demo card to about 46rem and centre the slide group vertically in the held window (use --ss-slack), or move 'Pause demos / Previous / Next' up under the copy column so the band closes.
